triggers: CREATE TRIGGER events_revision BEFORE INSERT ON write_guard BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'The events changed. Refresh and try again.') WHERE NEW.expected<>(SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='_revision'); END
tables: CREATE TABLE settings(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE entities(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,kind TEXT NOT NULL,ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',version INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(data)))
CREATE TABLE write_guard(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,expected TEXT NOT NULL)
